Ashwin Questions Team Management After Kuldeep Yadav's Inclusion

Cricketer Ravichandran Ashwin has reportedly questioned the team management's decisions, specifically regarding the inclusion of Kuldeep Yadav. Ashwin is quoted as saying that there seems to be a "lack of common sense" in the management's choices. The reports suggest this sentiment stems from the team selection for the India vs. West Indies (IND vs. WI) match.
